drivingQuestion: Are gourds included in vegetables for vows?
outcomeNote: R' Akiva rebuts; mishna does not decide.

segments.he: הַנּוֹדֵר מִן הַיָּרָק — מוּתָּר בַּדִּלּוּעִין, וְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא אוֹסֵר. אָמְרוּ לוֹ לְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא: וַהֲלֹא אוֹמֵר אָדָם לִשְׁלוּחוֹ ״קַח לִי יָרָק״, וְהוּא אוֹמֵר: ״לֹא מָצָאתִי אֶלָּא דִּלּוּעִין״.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» For «one who vows» that «vegetables» are forbidden «to» him, it «is permitted» for him «to» eat «gourds,» as people typically do not include gourds in the category of vegetables; «and Rabbi Akiva prohibits» him from eating gourds. The Rabbis «said to Rabbi Akiva: But doesn’t a person say to his agent: Purchase vegetables for me, and» the agent, after failing to find vegetables, returns with gourds and «says: I found only gourds?» This indicates that gourds are not considered vegetables.

segments.he: אָמַר לָהֶם: כֵּן הַדָּבָר, אוֹ שֶׁמָּא אוֹמֵר הוּא ״לֹא מָצָאתִי אֶלָּא קִיטְנִית״? אֶלָּא, שֶׁהַדִּלּוּעִין בִּכְלַל יָרָק, וְקִיטְנִית אֵינוֹ בִּכְלַל יָרָק. וְאָסוּר בְּפוֹל הַמִּצְרִי לַח, וּמוּתָּר בַּיָּבֵשׁ.
segments.en: Rabbi Akiva «said to them: The matter is so,» and that proves my opinion; «or perhaps,» does the agent return and «say: I found only legumes? Rather,» it is apparent «that gourds are included in» the category of «vegetables,» although they differ from other vegetables, and therefore, the agent purchases gourds and explains that he found only gourds. «And legumes are not included in» the category of «vegetables,» and that is why the agent dispatched to purchase vegetables would not purchase legumes at all. «And» for one who vows that vegetables are forbidden to him, it «is prohibited to» eat «the fresh cowpea», which is considered a vegetable, «and» it «is permitted to» eat «dry» cowpea, which is not a vegetable.
